data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 28/1746Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: NOAA HURRICANE HUNTERS INVESTIGATING POLO. ...CONDITIONS DETERIORATING OVER PORTIONS OF BAJA CALIFORNIA AS LIFE-THREATENING WINDS AND FLASH FLOODS EXPECTED TO OCCUR SOON... As of 11:00 AM MST Mon Sep 28 the center of Polo was located near 24.5, -113.5 with movement NE at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 964 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 115 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Rachel (EP3), advisory 28/1733Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL CONTINUES MOVING WEST-NORTHWESTWARD. As of 12:00 PM CST Mon Sep 28 the center of Rachel was located near 14.0, -101.5 with movement WNW at 8 mph. The minimum central pressure was 999 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 50 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Hanna (AT3), advisory 28/1500Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: TROPICAL STORM HANNA FORMS IN THE CENTRAL SUBTROPICAL ATLANTIC. As of 11:00 AM AST Mon Sep 28 the center of Hanna was located near 36.6, -50.4 with movement E at 17 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1006 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 45 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Fay (AT1), advisory 28/1439Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY MOVING SOUTH-SOUTHWESTWARD OVER THE CENTRAL ATLANTIC. As of 3:00 PM GMT Mon Sep 28 the center of Fay was located near 27.1, -44.6 with movement SSW at 9 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1011 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.
